language.description: python, javascript, typescript, sql (SQLite) or bash; only the ones installed on this device run

kind.description: write: implement something; fix: the starter runs but behaves wrongly; read: predict the starter's output, no editing; error: explain the error the starter produces

starter.description: starting code; required for fix, read and error

solution.description: your reference solution (write and fix): it must pass every test before the learner sees the task; never shown

tests.description: each test runs the program with `input` on stdin (for sql: setup statements run before the code) and compares its trimmed stdout with `expected`

predictFirst.description: ask the learner to commit to the expected output before running
